scope: Original MGS1998 stage12 attack armament, tactical footprints and finite chaff; exact source encounter guards retained.

implementation.telegraphs: Ground cells are committed before the next REX turn; ordinary reachable-cell movement can evade them. UI, board threat overlay and damage use the same cells.
implementation.radarMissiles: Three-cell salvo; active radar-phase chaff disperses two impacts and leaves one dangerous impact.
implementation.cockpitMissiles: Manual visual targeting; radar chaff does not blind Liquid. Current tactical restriction is declared adaptation, not a measured PS1 phase2 effect.
implementation.chaffDuration: Two completed REX attacks; other actors, UI reads and pause do not age it.
implementation.cost: One grenade and the active living squad hero turn. No HP payment, damage to radome/cockpit or Stinger shot.
implementation.ai: Uses the same movement, avoids marked cells and uses finite radar chaff when needed.
implementation.railgun: Preserved as physical lore/visual attachment; not used as a firing weapon in the source duel. Runtime enemy weapon tag is machine gun.

sourceReferences.type: Original PS1-era licensed Millennium Official Mission Handbook
sourceReferences.supports: Four attacks in both phases, medium-range guns/missiles, radar chaff makes most missiles miss, phase2 missiles manually aimed by Liquid.
sourceReferences.limits: OCR imperfect; numerical technical armament tables are not used to invent gameplay.

sourceReferences.type: Konami manual of original-game Master Collection port
sourceReferences.supports: Chaff interferes with electronic equipment. Five seconds is fuse time, not documented jamming duration.

adaptations: Stationary grid target, cells, directional footprints, damage factors and telegraph turns adapt the original 3D boss.
Three shared grenades, immediate resolution within a spent turn and two REX attacks of jamming are balance adaptations; no exact PS1 fuse/jam timing claimed.
One surviving impact out of a dispersed radar salvo is a tactical representation of most missiles missing, not measured source accuracy.
Cockpit grenade command disabled to avoid claiming that radar chaff blinds Liquid; the precise original phase2 missile-electronics interaction still requires replay.
Genome approach patrols and crossover hero equipment, field artifacts and broader Multiverse combat remain project systems.

browser.scope: Local real GameCanvas in isolated fixture; normal App root separately checked. No progress save injection, HP change, position injection or engine hooks in browser.

sourcePriorityRegression.fixtureUpdate: Uses an ordinary Snake/Chief/Leon squad and avoids telegraphed cells. Restores the isolated no-waiting fixture clock before battle; no application stats changed.
